description:
Hi,

Greetings

Hope you are doing great!

I would like to update you on an urgent open position with our esteemed client. Please go through the Job Description. Send me your updated resume and expected rate for the below position.

Role:Technology Analyst – SOA Testing
Duration: Full TIme
Location: Charlotte, NC

Qualifications
 Basic
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 2 years of experience with SOA Automation and Team co-ordination

Preferred 
•At least 2 years of experience with HP ALM/Quality Center
•At least 2+ plus years of experience on SOA Testing
•At least 2+ plus years of experience in test strategy and test Design
•At least 2+ plus years of experience in test execution analysis & reporting
•Good Analytical and problem solving skills
•Ability to work independently and take ownership
•Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment
•Translate user requirements and application features into testing requirements
•Knowledge of excel macros
•Familiarity with SOA automation framework
•Knowledge of Data Management will be an advantage
•Analytical skills


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
